name: Nattawadee Pipobpornchai
bio: Arhoung Nattawadee Pipobpornchai is an actor and singer from Chiang Mai, Thailand, managed by Mine Media Production.

credits.title: Inherit
credits.overview: Follows a wealthy family whose polished exterior begins to crack when an ancient centipede spirit infiltrates their bloodline.

credits.title: Not Friends
credits.overview: A group of high school students who dream of making films set out to make a short film based on the life of a classmate. However, they discover a secret that could change their vision of filmmaking forever.
